name: Shopee — Orders export
mapping_json: {"order_ref": "Order ID", "order_date": "Order Creation Date", "sku": "SKU Reference No.", "product_name": "Product Name", "variation": "Variation Name", "qty": "Quantity", "unit_price": "Deal Price", "gross_amount": "Product Subtotal", "discount": "Total Discount(PHP)", "shipping_fee": "Buyer Paid Shipping Fee", "net_amount": "Product Subtotal", "order_status": "Order Status", "buyer_name": "Username (Buyer)", "region": "Province"}

name: Lazada — Orders export
notes: Lazada Seller Center > Orders > Export. One row per order item; paidPrice already includes the shipping fee.
